title: Temporary privilege badging and KMS-signed evidence bundles for access reviews
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Periodic access reviews and ad-hoc investigations require proof that privileged access was time-bound, approved, and scoped correctly. Current exports produce noisy CSVs with limited linkage to the SSO session or SCIM delta that granted the entitlement. We need an audit-ready export format and workflow that ties temporary privilege badges, the approval chain, SAML/SSO session evidence, and SCIM delta events into a KMS-signed bundle suitable for compliance reviewers and long-term retention by residency policy.

Goal: Implement temporary privilege badging (time-boxed role grants with an approval record), capture provenance signals (SSO assertion IDs, SCIM change IDs, approver identity), and produce a signed evidence bundle per user-activation that can be queried by auditors or ingested into downstream GRC systems. Bundles should be residency-tagged and subject to retention rules.

Scope:
- Add a temporary privilege badge entity to RBAC model with start/end timestamps, justification text, and approval_reference.
- Emit structured SCIM delta events for badge issuance and revocation with stable IDs.
- Link SAML/SSO session metadata (assertion id, idp, session start/end) to badge lifecycle where available.
- Build an evidence bundle generator that collates role template, approval chain, SCIM deltas, SSO signals, and current entitlements into a compact JSONL+manifest file, signed by our KMS key and output as both JSONL and gzipped archive with a signed manifest.
- Add export retention metadata (residency, retention_period) and an API endpoint for on-demand bundle retrieval as well as scheduled exports for periodic reviews.
- Instrument Console (read-only) view for auditors to preview bundle contents with download links and provenance timestamps (rollout later).

Out of scope: full Console attestation UI (will be follow-up), on-prem agent for air-gapped KMS signing (separate Private deployment task).
acceptance_criteria: RBAC model accepts temporary_badge grants with start/end and justification
SCIM event stream includes stable badge-issue and badge-revoke events with unique IDs
Evidence bundle generator can produce a signed bundle containing: role template, approval chain, SCIM deltas, linked SSO assertion IDs, and a manifest
Bundles are residency-tagged and routed to retention pipeline based on residency policy
API endpoint returns bundle metadata and a signed download URL; scheduled export job can generate bundles for a tenant weekly
Basic Console preview shows provenance timeline and download button for auditors (feature-flagged)
architecture_decisions: Use a new badge table indexed by tenant_id + badge_id; store only references to approval records to avoid duplication
Emit SCIM delta as typed events in the existing change stream; include badge_id and prev_entitlement snapshot
Attach SSO signals by mapping session assertions we ingest at login to the user_id used in the badge grant; if no session found, mark as 'session_unlinked'
Generate evidence bundles as JSONL (one event per line) plus a signed manifest JSON; sign manifest using KMS asymmetric key and store signature alongside bundle in blobstore
Retention and residency metadata live in the bundle manifest and are used by existing retention export worker to route to appropriate storage (us-east, eu-west, etc.)
security_considerations: KMS signing: use tenant-scoped key-wrapping where possible; private deployments may need separate key material (out of scope)
Ensure bundles contain no raw secrets; strip tokens and only include opaque session IDs and hashes where necessary
Access to bundle generation API should require scoped service token and be audited; generation requests are logged with requestor id
Signed manifests ensure tamper-evidence; validate signature verification path for any consumer
Pseudonymize identifiers for exports destined for low-trust storage while keeping mapping in secure key-value for auditor rehydration
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (design + API): implement badge model and SCIM delta emission in staging; add internal feature flag to enable badge issuance
Phase 2 (evidence): implement bundle generator, KMS signing integration, and scheduled export runner; smoke-test with internal tenant
Phase 3 (auditor UX): add Console preview for auditors behind feature flag and document retrieval flow
Phase 4 (tenant opt-in + migration): allow tenants to opt into temporary badges and offer migration script to convert existing ad-hoc grants
Fallbacks: if SSO linkage fails, evidence bundle includes a clear 'unlinked' note but still contains approval record; ensure revocation path always revokes live badge

2025-01-23 - Jordan Lee: Spike completed to emit SCIM delta events for badge issuance; created schema 'badge_issue' with required fields. PR for event schema: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8354
2025-02-02 - Design review: PM suggested adding justification templates to reduce reviewer friction; added to ACs and schema as 'justification_template_id'.
2025-02-10 - Security review request submitted (SR-2025-04). Waiting on key rotation policy alignment for tenant-scoped signing.

2025-02-20 - Engineering: Implemented bundle generator prototype and KMS signing integration; internal smoke test passed for one internal tenant. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8421
2025-02-26 - QA: Found edge case where SCIM delta ordering caused manifest mismatch when multiple revokes occurred in same second; added deterministic sort by sequence_id to generator.
2025-02-28 - Jordan Lee: Cut feature-flag for badge issuance in staging; beginning scheduled export job tests for EU residency routing.
